title: Resource Intelligence Foundation: Provenance, Permissions & Persistent Resource Model
research_question: Can external software resources be represented as persistent, provenance-aware, version-aware, permission-controlled entities that can later be integrated into the LIFECORE-SWE world model without contaminating the verified internal code graph?
components_implemented: lifecore_swe.resources.models (ResourceType, ResourceRecord, FreshnessPolicy, hashing, URL canonicalization)
lifecore_swe.resources.store (ResourceStore SQLite persistence: resources, provenance, resource_versions)
lifecore_swe.resources.registry (ResourceRegistry deduplication, versioning, freshness & verification lifecycle)
security_boundary_isolation: VERIFIED (Zero contamination of GraphIndex, ExperienceGraphOverlay, or NegativeGraphOverlay)
